verdict.rationale: Rippling documents its own bulk operations, but only within benefits: uploading a carrier EOI file updates coverage and payroll deductions in bulk, and dependent approvals and EOI routing run in bulk. Nothing in the evidence shows general-purpose bulk editing across employees, apps or records, or bulk endpoints for programmatic or AI-driven use. Missing for 10: general bulk actions beyond the benefits/EOI domain, bulk API or CLI operations for AI-native workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Upload a carrier EOI file and Rippling matches each decision to the right employee, updates their coverage, and adjusts payroll deductions in bulk.
